    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    markers = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(g) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 5]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # The marker surrounded by the colored pattern is the source; the other is the target.
    def adjacent_color(p):
        r, c = p
        return sum(1 for dr, dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))
                   if 0 <= r+dr < h and 0 <= c+dc < w and g[r+dr][c+dc] not in (0,5))
    src = max(markers, key=adjacent_color)
    dst = min((p for p in markers if p != src), key=adjacent_color)
    sr, sc = src
    tr, tc = dst
    shape = [(r-sr, c-sc, v) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row)
             if v not in (0,5)]
    for dr, dc, v in shape:
        rr, cc = tr+dr, tc+dc
        if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
            g[rr][cc] = v
    g[tr][tc] = 0
    return g
